utility.name: PHP 8.2 patched against php2shell (Debian 12 Bookworm security build)
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Ensures the Debian 12 php8.2 on the box carries the php2shell fix (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) by refreshing the apt cache and pinning the php8.2 core packages to the fixed Debian security build (>= 8.2.35-1~deb12u1, DLA-4848-1). A module that installs a PHP application on bookworm php8.2 requires this so the php2shell vector is closed and only its own application vulnerability is exploitable. It runs before the requiring module, so the application's own php packages resolve to the same fixed version (php8.2-* are versioned in lockstep). The 7.4 counterpart is php7_patched (a source build, since 7.4 has no fixed package).
